task.description: WF-02 Step 5 re-verification (rework_count 1) of REQ-113's AC1-AC6 following CODE-DESIGNER's design rework (376bb81/df5b2a9) and ELIXIR-DEV's script rework (dc93092/cf28a46) that fixed the parsing regex to match this toolchain's real 'Result: .../Failed: ...' mix test output shape, and re-passed Steps 2c/2d/3 (af8b6c4, 5360f7f, 6c55a33).
acceptance_criteria: AC1: same combined pass/fail/property totals as single-process mix test, demonstrated side by side
AC2: aggregation actually sums/cross-checks each partition's reported counts, not just process exit
AC3: exits non-zero on any partition failure (demonstrated by injecting one), exits zero when all pass
AC4: N derived from nproc/platform equivalent or explicit configured default, never hardcoded
AC5: pre-compiles MIX_ENV=test exactly once before launching any partition
AC6: script lives under scripts/, not lib/ or test/

result.summary: Confirmed branch feature/WF02-REQ113-20260821, commit 6c55a33. Re-ran plain `mix test` baseline (exit 0, 'Result: 1274 passed (5 properties, 1269 tests)', 265.2s) and scripts/test_parallel.sh multiple times: TEST_PARALLEL_N=2 clean run matched the baseline exactly ('combined: 1269 tests, 5 properties, 0 failures (1274/1274 passed)', exit 0); TEST_PARALLEL_N=2 with a temporary injected failing assertion in test/letflow/api/error_test.exs (reverted via `git checkout --`, confirmed clean, never committed) correctly parsed 1 failure and exited 1, with the modified partition's own raw exit code 2 (this toolchain's real ExUnit-failure exit code) correctly not conflated with the script's own collapsed exit contract. A separate real N=8 (nproc-derived, no override) run independently confirmed the parser correctly sums genuine non-injected per-partition failures (verified against raw per-partition logs by hand: partition 6 'Failed: 1 test' -> parsed 1; partition 7 'Failed: 16 tests' -> parsed 16, both exact matches) -- this run also surfaced a real environment-capacity finding (Postgres 'too_many_connections' under 8-way full-pool concurrency, config/test.exs pool_size = schedulers_online()*2 = 16/partition, plus Mix's own build-directory lock serializing partition startup) that is NOT a script/parsing defect (the script correctly reported the real failures/aborts it saw) but does mean N=8/nproc is not currently collision-free on this host's Postgres config -- documented as a follow-up recommendation, not a REQ-113 AC failure, since no AC requires collision-freedom at arbitrary N. AC4 (env override + nproc derivation), AC5 (single pre-compile, ordering confirmed both by source and live run output), AC6 (path) verified directly against source and live runs and PASS.
issues: Environment-capacity finding (not an AC failure): running scripts/test_parallel.sh at N=8 (this host's real nproc) triggers Postgres 'too_many_connections' due to config/test.exs's per-partition pool_size (schedulers_online()*2=16) times 8 partitions, plus Mix's own build-lock serialization bunching connection acquisition into a burst. Recommend a follow-up requirement/decision record on pool_size vs max-partition-count; TEST_PARALLEL_N override already provides a safe workaround today.
